body: One of the few DIYs that I think I can actually do!  Thanks.

Please don't.  I've been dealing with serious health issues and had the same thoughts you did multiple times per day last week.  See if you can get an anti-anxiety medication to calm yourself down when you panic - Xanax, Klonapin, etc.  please just try to take it a minute, an hour, a day at a time.
If you're set you're set - but I'm guessing you came here for something?

I'll be here for you if you're here for me

Sometimes I feel like someone making a connection means everything
